notes:
CINEMATIC BACKDROPS. The artwork is now part of the interface instead of something hidden behind it.

THE TV TITLE PAGE. The backdrop fills the whole screen. It used to be a band across the top with plain black underneath it, which on a 16:9 TV was most of the picture you were looking at. The information sits down the left over a soft wash, the right of the frame stays clear, and the title, year, runtime, rating, genres and synopsis each carry a subtle shadow so they stay readable whatever the artwork is doing behind them. My list is now the accented button and Trailer sits beside it. A film's stream list is sized to the cards rather than stretching across the frame, and a series keeps its full-width episode list exactly as before.

THE TV HOME BANNER. The same black panel used to cover the left of the featured title's artwork. It is a light wash now, so you can actually see the image the banner is built from.

THE DESKTOP DETAILS PAGE. The backdrop there was dimmed twice over, leaving about three per cent of it visible on the left. It reads properly now, with the title, cast and synopsis given the same shadow treatment.

Nothing about how any of these pages work has changed - same streams, same addons, same playback, same navigation, same remote controls.
